privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.commitment.title: Our Commitment to Privacy
privacy.commitment.desc: At NotThisDate, we believe privacy is a fundamental right. We collect only what's necessary to provide you with a great scheduling experience.
privacy.whatWeCollect.title: What We Collect
privacy.whatWeCollect.creators: For Calendar Creators: Email address (for authentication), calendar data you create.
privacy.whatWeCollect.participants: For Participants: Name and unavailable dates you submit. No account required.
privacy.whatWeDont.title: What We Don't Do
privacy.whatWeDont.item3: We don't track you across websites
privacy.rights.title: Your Rights
privacy.rights.desc: You can access, delete, or export your data at any time. Just delete your calendars to remove all associated data.
